rules: Traffic should preferentially arise from real infrastructure, population and operational needs.
A facility's existence may create recurring traffic demand.
Traffic may be delayed, diverted, cancelled or interrupted by campaign events.
Distant traffic may be simulated at lower fidelity but remains temporally coherent.
Local traffic becomes higher fidelity as it approaches player relevance.
A random encounter should ideally be an intersection with existing traffic/activity rather than an entity spawned solely for the encounter.
